name: Generate images of all DWI volumes and create gif
summary: Generates a slice PNG of every volume of a DWI with FSL slicer and combines them into an animated GIF with ImageMagick, for quick volume-by-volume QA.
description: Splits the DWI into single volumes with fslsplit, renders mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of each with FSL slicer, and assembles the PNGs into raw/out.gif with ImageMagick convert. Use it to spot corrupted volumes, signal dropout or motion across the series.

inputs.description: DWI image (NIfTI); bvecs and bvals are passed along but not used.

outputs.description: Directory with one PNG per DWI volume (vol0000.png, ...), out.gif animating them, and out.png (the first volume).

failure_modes.message: something failed. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log for errors from fslsplit, slicer or convert.
